title: 第19章 来自爷奶的关怀
novel_title: 1960：九个妹妹把我宠上天(天下第九)
content_zh: 木门“吱呀——”一声响。门轴上没上油，一推就发出刺耳的声音。院子里铺着凹凸不平的泥地，角落里堆着几根干枯的柴火，靠近屋檐的地方，还晾着一些刚挖回来的野菜，蔫蔫的没一点精神。而在院子中间的石磨旁，坐着两个白发苍苍的老人，正是爷爷奶奶。奶奶正低着头，手里拿着针线缝补一件破得没法再破的衣服，针脚歪歪扭扭的，她的眼睛不太好，缝几下就得把线凑到眼前瞅一瞅。爷爷则坐在旁边，手里拿着个烟袋锅子，却没点着，只是有一下没一下地摩挲着，眉头皱得紧紧的，不知道在想什么。听到推门声，二老同时抬起头，当看到是辰楠时，脸上露出笑容，他们的金孙回来了。可是——当他们看到辰楠手里拿着的东西时，震惊得瞪大双眼。辰楠左手提着一个麻包袋，右手拉拽着一头野猪，没错，就是一头野猪！奶奶手里的针线“啪嗒”一声掉在了地上。爷爷手里的烟袋锅子也差点没拿稳，两人的嘴巴张得能塞进一个鸡蛋，下巴都快掉在地上了。“我的好大孙诶，你、你、你……”奶奶的声音都在发颤，她使劲揉了揉眼睛，生怕自已看错了。在这连饭都吃不饱的年月，别说是野猪了，就是能看到一只兔子，都能让全村人眼馋半天。爷爷赶紧站起身，脚步有些踉跄地走过来，围着辰楠转了一圈，眼睛死死盯着野猪，又紧张地看向辰楠。“乖孙子诶，你没受伤吧？快让爷看看！”他一边说，一边伸手去摸辰楠的胳膊，生怕孙子受了伤。没想到今天孙子回来了，而且还带了一整头野猪回来，看野猪的样子是刚断气没多久。“爷，奶，你们放心，我没事！一点伤都没有。”辰楠咧嘴一笑，感受到二老的关心他只觉得心里很暖和。原主的记忆里，这大山里确实有很多大型动物，豺狼虎豹猪牛羊都有，但很少有人敢去招惹，毕竟没点本事的人进山只会弄得一身伤甚至是丢掉性命。奶奶还是不放心，拉着辰楠的手，从头到脚仔细看了一遍，浑身上下并没有伤口。见辰楠身上有些淤青，奶奶心疼不已：“你这是被野猪撞了？”不过看到他人没事，安全归来。“没事就好，没事就好……你这孩子，吓死奶奶了，以后可别上山冒险了，山里去不得啊！就算没肉吃，咱也不能拿命去拼啊！”爷爷也跟着点头，拿起烟袋锅子猛吸了一口，语气也缓和了不少：“你奶说得对，安全最重要，不过……这野猪，是怎么来的？”他还是有点不敢相信，自家孙子平时都在城里住，连野猪都没见过，又怎么可能杀死一头野猪。他孙子可没有打野猪的本事，内心愈发的觉得这是捡来的野猪。辰楠挠了挠头，笑着说：“运气好，回来的路上看见，就捡了回来。”他可不敢说这是自已杀死的野猪，主要是说出去爷奶也不仅不信，还会担忧他的安危。多一事不如少一事。二老听了这话，把目光重新投向地上的野猪，眼神里满是激动。这可是好多好多肉啊！如今粮食紧缺，每家每户都要勒紧裤腰带过日子，谁家也没有那么多肉。不过……这明显就是刚杀死的野猪，这是能捡到的吗？这不可能是孙子打到的猎物，难道真的是捡来的？猎人打猎都不要猎物了吗？野猪头颅上还镶嵌着一把砍柴刀，这是被砍死的野猪，失主不会找上门来吧？爷爷把自已的担忧说了出来。辰楠安慰了爷爷几句，虽然不好明说这是自已猎杀的野猪，但他深知肯定不会有失主找来的。奶奶蹲下身，伸出手轻轻摸了摸野猪的皮毛，嘴里喃喃道：“这么大一头猪，这得有多少肉啊……”一提到肉，两人的情绪都有些复杂。他们太清楚现在的情况了——60年初，粮食紧缺到了极点。家家户户的存粮早就见了底，每天只能靠挖野菜、捋槐花、剥树皮填肚子。有时候挖回来的野菜有毒，吃了上吐下泻，也只能硬扛着。爷爷叹了口气，声音低沉地说：“前几天听隔壁村的老王说，他们村已经饿死人了，还是个半大的孩子，就因为多饿了两顿，没撑住……”他的眼神暗了暗，“咱们村现在还好，可再这么下去，估计也快了。”奶奶的眼泪一下子就掉了下来，抹了抹眼睛说：“可不是嘛，村东头的老李头，昨天还来咱家借粮，我也只能把一点糠麸给了他，那点东西，根本不够塞牙缝的……”他们家也有那么多人要养，根本就没有余粮。若非城里有辰楠家两个双职工，他们家早就坚持不住。辰楠听着二老的话，心里也不好受。看到眼前这两位老人因为粮食发愁，甚至要面对饿死人的惨状，还是忍不住心疼。没办法，缺粮食是常态，大部分人都这样。他拍了拍奶奶的肩膀，安慰道：“阿奶，你别担心，现在不是有这头野猪了吗？这够咱们吃一段时间了。”匹夫无罪，怀璧其罪，他可不会把野猪拿出去分，这点肉都不够他们家吃的。即便真拿出去分，那么多人也分不了多少。这个时候就不能有圣母心，唯有顾及好了自已，才有闲工夫去顾及他人。爷爷眼睛一亮，赶紧说：“乖孙说得对！这野猪可不能上交！”“现在公社里的粮食也紧张，交上去说不定就被分没了。”“咱们自已留着，不仅能让家里的老小活下去，还能让大伙补补身子。”奶奶也连连点头：“对对对，不上交！咱们偷偷处理了，把肉腌起来慢慢；不过这事得小心点，不能让村里人知道，免得引来麻烦。”在这缺粮的年代，谁家有肉都能让别人眼红，要是被人知道他们家有一头野猪，指不定会出什么事。
content_en: The wooden door "squeaked".There was no oil on the door shaft and it made a squeaking sound when pushed.The yard was paved with uneven mud, and there were a few dry firewood piled in the corner. Near the eaves, there were some freshly dug wild vegetables hanging out to dry, looking wilted and lifeless.Sitting next to the stone mill in the middle of the yard were two gray-haired old people, their grandparents.Grandma was lowering her head, holding a needle and thread in her hand to mend a piece of clothing that was extremely torn. The stitches were crooked, and her eyesight was not very good, so she had to bring the thread up to her eyes to take a look after sewing a few times.Grandpa was sitting next to him, holding a cigarette pot in his hand, but he didn't light it, he just rubbed it from time to time, his brows were furrowed tightly, and he didn't know what he was thinking.Hearing the sound of pushing the door open, the two elders raised their heads at the same time. When they saw it was Chen Nan, a smile appeared on their faces. Their golden grandson was back.But - when they saw what Chen Nan was holding, their eyes widened in shock.Chen Nan was holding a sack in his left hand and pulling a wild boar in his right hand. Yes, it was a wild boar!The needle and thread in grandma's hand fell to the ground with a "clack".Grandpa almost lost his grip on the pipe pot in his hand. Their mouths were open enough to fit an egg in, and their jaws almost fell to the ground."My grandson, you, you, you..." Grandma's voice was trembling, and she rubbed her eyes vigorously, for fear that she had seen wrongly.In these days when people don’t even have enough to eat, the sight of a rabbit, let alone a wild boar, can make the whole village hungry for a long time.Grandpa quickly stood up, walked over with some staggering steps, and circled around Chen Nan. He stared at the wild boar with his eyes, and then looked at Chen Nan nervously."My dear grandson, are you not hurt? Let me take a look!" He said while reaching out to touch Chen Nan's arm, for fear that his grandson would be injured.Unexpectedly, my grandson came back today and brought back a whole wild boar. It looked like the wild boar had just died."Master, grandma, don't worry, I'm fine! I'm not hurt at all." Chen Nan grinned, feeling warm in his heart when he felt the care from his two elders.In the memory of the original owner, there were indeed many large animals in the mountains, including jackals, tigers, leopards, pigs, cattle and sheep, but few people dared to provoke them. After all, incompetent people entering the mountains would only get injured or even lose their lives.Grandma was still worried. She took Chen Nan's hand and looked carefully from head to toe. There were no wounds on her body.Seeing some bruises on Chen Nan's body, grandma felt distressed: "Did you get hit by a wild boar?" However, she saw that the others were fine and returned safely."It's okay, it's okay... You kid scared grandma to death. Don't take risks in the mountains anymore. You can't go in the mountains! Even if we don't have meat to eat, we can't risk our lives!" Grandpa also nodded, picked up the pipe and took a deep puff of the pot, sayingHis anger also eased a lot: "You're right, safety is the most important thing, but...where did this wild boar come from?" He still couldn't believe it. His grandson usually lived in the city and had never seen a wild boar, so how could he kill a wild boar.His grandson had no ability to hunt wild boars, and he felt more and more that this was a picked wild boar.Chen Nan scratched his head and said with a smile: "I'm lucky. I saw it on the way back and picked it up." He didn't dare to say that it was a wild boar that he had killed. The main reason was that his grandma would not only not believe it, but would also worry about his safety.It is better to do less than to do more.After hearing this, the second elder turned his attention back to the wild boar on the ground, his eyes full of excitement.This is a lot of meat!Nowadays, food is in short supply, and every household has to tighten their belts to get by, and no one has that much meat.But... this is obviously a freshly killed wild boar. Can this be picked up?This couldn't be the prey that the grandson had shot. Could it be that he really picked it up?Hunters don’t want prey anymore when hunting?There is also a woodcutter embedded in the wild boar's head. This is a wild boar that was chopped to death. The owner won't come looking for it, right?Grandpa expressed his worries.Chen Nan comforted his grandfather a few words. Although it was difficult to say clearly that this was a wild boar that he had hunted, he knew that no owner would find it.Grandma squatted down, stretched out her hand and gently touched the wild boar's fur, and murmured: "How much meat does such a big pig have to have..." When it came to meat, both of them had complicated emotions.They are very aware of the current situation - in the early 1960s, food shortages were extreme.Every household's food reserves have long since reached their lowest point, and they can only rely on digging wild vegetables, stroking locust flowers, and peeling bark from trees to fill their stomachs every day.Sometimes the wild vegetables dug up are poisonous, causing vomiting and diarrhea, so we have to carry them around.Grandpa sighed and said in a low voice: "A few days ago, I heard Mr. Wang from the next village say that people in their village have starved to death. He was still a half-year-old child, and he couldn't hold on because he was hungry for two extra meals..." His eyes darkened, "Our village is fine now, but if it continues like this, it will probably be over soon."Grandma's tears suddenly fell down. She wiped her eyes and said, "That's right. Old Li Tou from the east end of the village came to our house yesterday to borrow food. I could only give him a little bran. That little thing was not enough to fill the gap between my teeth..." There were so many people in their family to support, and there was no surplus food at all.If it weren't for the fact that there were two dual-income earners in the city, Chen Nan's family would have been unable to hold on long ago.Chen Nan felt uncomfortable listening to the second elder's words.Seeing these two old men in front of me worrying about food and even facing the tragic situation of starving to death, I still couldn't help but feel sad.There is no way, lack of food is normal, most people are like this.He patted his grandma on the shoulder and comforted him: "Grandma, don't worry. Isn't there this wild boar now? This will be enough for us to eat for a while." The common man is not guilty, but he is guilty of the crime. He will not take the wild boar out to divide it. This little meat is not enough for their family.Even if it were really shared, so many people wouldn't be able to share much.At this time, we cannot have the heart of the Holy Mother. Only when we take care of ourselves can we have free time to take care of others.Grandpa's eyes lit up and he quickly said: "My dear grandson is right! You can't hand over this wild boar!" "Food in the commune is also tight now. If you hand it in, it might be divided." "We keep it for ourselves, not only to keep the family alive, but also to help everyone recuperate." Grandma also nodded repeatedly:"Yes, yes, don't hand it over! We handled it secretly and marinated the meat slowly; but we have to be careful not to let the villagers know, so as not to cause trouble." In this era of food shortage, anyone who has meat in their home can make others jealous. If someone knows that they have a wild boar, something might happen.
